critical_code_review_comments: iptv.ts uses `(globalThis as any).require("expo-audio")` dynamic resolution — works because expo-audio is not installed, so it silently returns granted:false on native. Fine for Faz A (voice search is Faz B), but ensure Faz B adds expo-audio to package.json before shipping mic feature.

playlist-select.tsx auto-timer countdown is not cancelable via keyboard-only (D-Pad); only touch/click on 'cancel-auto-btn' stops it. TV Box users pressing D-Pad Down to focus the list will still trigger auto-advance at t=0. Consider cancelling on any onFocus event of a playlist cell.

add-playlist.tsx: after successful add, navigates directly to /(tabs) — skips playlist-select entirely. This is intentional (new playlist becomes active), but means the 'SON' badge/countdown flow is only reachable via existing multi-playlist users.
seed_data_creation: None. Public M3U https://iptv-org.github.io/iptv/countries/tr.m3u used for live client-side parse test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Native-only surfaces (cleartext HTTP on Android WebView, runtime permission prompts, expo-notifications actual push registration) can only be validated after APK rebuild — web preview covers config-level correctness only. If Faz B lands (DVR/Chromecast native modules, expo-audio for voice), retest the permissions.ts dynamic-require branches on a real device. Backend /api/m3u/* and /api/xtream/* endpoints are still live but now unused by the client — safe to remove in a future cleanup pass, but keep for now (backward compat with any older builds).
